description: Fixed multi-instrument set for T2-20. The list and the parameters are frozen before the run: changing either requires a new version and a new report.
selection_rule: Liquid MOEX shares with at least 4 years of 4h history in the database.
One set of parameters for every ticker: no per-ticker tuning (ADR-022).
TP 2.5 / SL 2.0 is a non-edge cell of the SBER 4h heatmap, not the best one: the best cell (TP 3.0 / SL 2.5) had no plateau and would move overfitting onto 20 instruments (ADR-021, ADR-022).
The list is selected by today's liquidity, which is survivorship bias: delisted and merged tickers are absent. Recorded as a limitation in ADR-022.

excluded.CRU6: futures: different margin and tick model
excluded.POSI: recent listing: short history distorts the comparison
excluded.HEAD: recent listing: short history distorts the comparison
excluded.ASTR: recent listing: short history distorts the comparison
excluded.SVCB: recent listing: short history distorts the comparison

dividend_note: Candles are not dividend-adjusted (verified on 2026-10-30: SBER 2024-07-11 -8.44%, SNGSP 2025-07-17 -14.06%). Ex-dividend gaps hit stops as if they were market moves; the report counts overnight gaps >= 3% per ticker.
